species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 57°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 14–30 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
East wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
